milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the redstone torch and face it to demonstrate they've found it. The torch is at spawn-relative (8, 2, 7) on a cobblestone pillar, ~10 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actively walk at least ~5 blocks toward the torch (cannot be satisfied at spawn where distance is ~10). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the torch.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the black wool inside the shelter and face it. The wool is at spawn-relative (14, 1, 13) inside an oak plank structure, ~18 blocks from spawn. max_distance=8 allows the player to satisfy this from the shelter entrance (z=10, ~3 blocks from wool) or from inside, but not from outside the shelter's vicinity. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the wool blocks.
